surfaceAdditions.reason: `AlertDialog.Portal` is `Dialog.Portal`. With `disabled`, the portal element and its parts render in the place of the part, also on a server (`VUE-128`). Base UI has no such prop.

The part gives `disabled` to `Dialog.Trigger`, which reads it for its state and for `useButton`, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the trigger, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

The part gives `id` to its element, or a generated id when `id` is absent, so it is a declared prop. The popup names the `id` that the element has in `aria-labelledby` and follows a change of it. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the title, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

The part gives `id` to its element, or a generated id when `id` is absent, so it is a declared prop. The popup names the `id` that the element has in `aria-describedby` and follows a change of it. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the description, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
